options.reason: The table pairs 120 CPTAC-BRCA tumour proteomes (12,623 protein-abundance columns) with a two-level ER-status label (81 positive, 39 negative), matching the brief's aim of predicting oestrogen-receptor status from protein abundance. Binary classification with cross-validated classifier comparison (discrimination, calibration, decision curves) is the evident purpose; sample_id is a row key and label must never be a feature. Many protein columns are sparse/highly missing and some are constant, so feature filtering belongs inside the CV pipeline, and no group or chronology columns exist since each row is an independent tumour.
